## TASK-MTU6I7SO2BD28 — COMPLETED (marketplace/client.tsx)
Fixed: src/app/[locale]/(app)/[workspace]/marketplace/client.tsx (the file listed above at
line 5, "marketplace/client.tsx (41 literals, file has NO t() at all)").
All 41 scanner-flagged literals plus ~30 additional hardcoded strings the scanner missed
(mixed JSX-text-plus-expression nodes like "Pazar Yeri İlanları ({listings.length})" and
ternary strings like {isPublishing ? 'Yayınlanıyor...' : ...}) were moved to a new `m8`
next-intl namespace, added to both messages/tr.json and messages/en.json (English is a real
translation, not a copy of the Turkish). Key naming follows the existing `m9` namespace
pattern in the same catalogs (moduleId -> section -> field, e.g. m8.header.moduleLabel,
m8.postForm.titleLabel). One thing intentionally left untouched: `.toLocaleDateString('tr-TR')`
on the API key created-at column — that's a date-formatting locale code, not a translatable
string, and switching it to the active locale is a separate, larger change outside this task's
single-file scope.

Verification (run 2026-09-09, this pane only — other panes' DB/port were not touched):
